IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_LNS_ACCTPARTITION' and table_schema = 'D360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_LNS_ACCTPARTITION;
END;

CREATE TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_LNS_ACCTPARTITION]
( 
	[H]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	B2K_ID	VARCHAR (48)  NULL,
	B2K_TYPE	VARCHAR (20)  NULL,
	BANK_ID	VARCHAR (32)  NULL,
	CUST_ID	VARCHAR (36)  NULL,
	PARTITIONED_ACID	VARCHAR (44)  NULL,
	PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM	VARCHAR (16)  NULL,
	PART_TRAN_TYPE	CHAR (1)  NULL,
	PSTD_FLG	CHAR (1)  NULL,
	SOL_ID	VARCHAR (32)  NULL,
	SUPERCEDED_AFTER_RENEWAL	CHAR (1)  NULL,
	TRAN_AMT	NUMERIC (22)  NULL,
	TRAN_CRNCY_CODE	VARCHAR (12)  NULL,
	TRAN_DATE [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	TRAN_ID	VARCHAR (36)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime2](7)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO

 DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,

GO
